facts.assertion: Planning Data documentation says its API provides access to over 100 planning and housing datasets for England through one interface.
The documented coordinate query uses latitude and longitude to return entities whose geometry intersects the supplied point.
The coordinate-query contract allows multiple dataset parameters in a single request.
Planning Data explicitly warns that no query result does not prove that no constraint exists because coverage varies by area.
Planning Data documents WGS84 EPSG:4326 coordinates for geometry queries.
For portfolio screening the API has no batch endpoint and documents one request per property.
For hundreds of properties or more, Planning Data recommends bulk downloads and local spatial intersections.
The current Brownfield land dataset reports 37,666 records.
The current Brownfield land dataset reports 354 data providers.
The Brownfield land collector last ran on 23 July 2026.
The Brownfield land dataset says new data was last found on 22 July 2026.
Planning Data states the Brownfield land dataset origin is all data from authoritative sources.
The current Article 4 direction area dataset reports 7,152 areas and 111 data providers.
The Article 4 direction area collector and newest-data dates are both 24 July 2026.
The Conservation area dataset is explicitly described as incomplete and containing duplicates that are still being reconciled.
